summary: VB6 legacy application with COM dependencies, MDI interface, and ADO data access patterns requiring modernization to ASP.NET Core MVC with Razor Pages

rules.rule: Forms prefixed with 'frm' followed by functional description
Child forms use MDIChild = -1 'True for multi-document interface
Data access through ADO 2.5 COM objects and Data Environment designers
Controls prefixed with type abbreviation (txt, cmd, lbl) followed by purpose

lint_recommendations: Replace VB6 form events with ASP.NET Core controller actions
Convert ADO Recordsets to Entity Framework Core DbContext
Replace COM references with .NET Standard libraries
Implement proper async/await patterns for data operations
Add input validation and sanitization for all user inputs
Replace MDI interface with responsive web UI layout
scaffold_templates: ASP.NET Core MVC controller template for form-to-action mapping
Razor Page template for VB6 form UI preservation
Entity Framework model template for ADO data structures
Authentication middleware template for login form replacement
Repository pattern template for data access layer modernization
